key_idea: An arrow always points to someone shorter.
steps: E points to A, A points to B, and B points to D. Each one is taller than the next.
C points to D too, so C is also taller than D.
Nobody gets an arrow from D, so D is not taller than anyone. D is the shortest.

choice_feedback.A: A has an arrow to B, so A is taller than B.
choice_feedback.B: B has an arrow to D, so B is taller than D.
choice_feedback.C: C has an arrow to D, so C is taller than D.
choice_feedback.E: E is at the top of the line, so E is the tallest.
